title: Australian Tomato Soup
description: A fresh and zesty take on the classic soup, made with Australian ingredients.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the Australian tomatoes, vegetable broth, and chopped basil to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
